stories.headline: The hosts could go level on points with top of the table Weymouth tonight with…
stories.body: The hosts could go level on points with top of the table Weymouth tonight with a win, but Weymouth have a 13 goal superior goal difference on Marine, having played a game less ahead of this evening.
stories.source_title: Monday Night Preview | Two Southern League matches as well as a huge all Southern League FA Cup Round One tie between Plymouth Parkway and Berkhamsted
stories.author: Jack Phillips

stories.headline: The Spitfires recent record sees them coming into this fixture on the back of back-to-back…
stories.body: The Spitfires recent record sees them coming into this fixture on the back of back-to-back wins over two sides in the relegation zone in Bristol Manor Farm, beating them 1-2 at The Creek, and a big 6-0 win over Melksham Town at home in their most recent game on October 31, where five different players got on the scoresheet, including a brace from Marcel Lewis.
stories.source_title: Monday Night Preview | Two Southern League matches as well as a huge all Southern League FA Cup Round One tie between Plymouth Parkway and Berkhamsted
stories.author: Jack Phillips

stories.headline: United picked up a big win, beating third place Dorchester Town 2-1, coming from 0-1…
stories.body: United picked up a big win, beating third place Dorchester Town 2-1, coming from 0-1 down thanks to goals from Jensen Wakefield in the 60th minute and Ben Starr in the 77th minute.

stories.author: Jack Phillips

stories.headline: Striker for The White Horse Men Leighton Thomas is third in the Division One South’s…
stories.body: Striker for The White Horse Men Leighton Thomas is third in the Division One South’s top scorer charts with 10 goals, and will be hungry for more after two games without a goal, following a hat-trick in a 4-0 win over Willand Rovers.

stories.headline: Like Redditch United and Peterborough Sports, the two sides also met on September 29 in…
stories.body: Like Redditch United and Peterborough Sports, the two sides also met on September 29 in the league this season, where after a 14th minute red card for Marine’s Joe Shepherd, Westbury United came away with a 3-0 win thanks to Joshua Jenkins opener in the 23rd minute, before a brace by Ben Starr in the 41st and 67th minute.
